schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS EDI_PSI_HDR (ODBC_ID VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY, TRANSACTION_SET VARCHAR(5), CUST_ID VARCHAR(15), ST_ID VARCHAR(15), PO_NUM VARCHAR(22), V_STATUS VARCHAR(20), V_STATUS_DT DATETIME)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CUSTOMER (ID VARCHAR(15) PRIMARY KEY, SALESREP_ID VARCHAR(15), TERRITORY VARCHAR(15))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CUST_ADDRESS (CUSTOMER_ID VARCHAR(15), ADDR_NO INT, NAME VARCHAR(50), ADDR_1 VARCHAR(50), ADDR_2 VARCHAR(50), ADDR_3 VARCHAR(50), CITY VARCHAR(50), STATE VARCHAR(50), ZIPCODE VARCHAR(15), COUNTRY VARCHAR(15), SHIPTO_ID VARCHAR(15), PRIMARY KEY (CUSTOMER_ID, ADDR_NO))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CUSTOMER_ORDER (ID VARCHAR(15) PRIMARY KEY, CUSTOMER_PO_REF VARCHAR(22), SHIPTO_ID VARCHAR(15))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE (CUST_ORDER_ID VARCHAR(15), PART_ID VARCHAR(30), PROMISE_DEL_DATE DATETIME, TOTAL_SHIPPED_QTY DECIMAL(14,4), PRIMARY KEY (CUST_ORDER_ID, PART_ID))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS EDI_PSI_DTL (ODBC_ID VARCHAR(10), ITEM_NO VARCHAR(30), ATTRIBUTE_1 CHAR(1), PRIMARY KEY (ODBC_ID, ITEM_NO))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO EDI_PSI_HDR (ODBC_ID, TRANSACTION_SET, CUST_ID, ST_ID, PO_NUM, V_STATUS, V_STATUS_DT) SELECT RIGHT('0000' + CAST(n AS VARCHAR), 4), '830', 'C01558', 'ST001', CONCAT('PO', n), 'READY', GETDATE() FROM (SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, {row_count}) AS n) AS series
INSERT INTO CUSTOMER (ID, SALESREP_ID, TERRITORY) SELECT CONCAT('CUST', n), CONCAT('REP', n), CONCAT('TERR', n) FROM (SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, 100) AS n) AS series

INSERT INTO CUST_ADDRESS (CUSTOMER_ID, ADDR_NO, NAME, ADDR_1, ADDR_2, ADDR_3, CITY, STATE, ZIPCODE, COUNTRY, SHIPTO_ID) SELECT CONCAT('CUST', n), n, CONCAT('Name', n), CONCAT('Addr1', n), CONCAT('Addr2', n), CONCAT('Addr3', n), CONCAT('City', n), CONCAT('State', n), CONCAT('Zip', n), 'Country', CONCAT('ST', n) FROM (SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, 100) AS n) AS series
INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_ORDER (ID, CUSTOMER_PO_REF, SHIPTO_ID) SELECT CONCAT('ORD', n), CONCAT('PO', n), CONCAT('ST', n) FROM (SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, 100) AS n) AS series

INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE (CUST_ORDER_ID, PART_ID, PROMISE_DEL_DATE, TOTAL_SHIPPED_QTY) SELECT CONCAT('ORD', n), CONCAT('PART', n), GETDATE() + n, 0 FROM (SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, 100) AS n) AS series
INSERT INTO EDI_PSI_DTL (ODBC_ID, ITEM_NO, ATTRIBUTE_1) SELECT RIGHT('0000' + CAST(n AS VARCHAR), 4), CONCAT('ITEM', n), 'C' FROM (SELECT n FROM generate_series(1, {row_count}) AS n) AS series
